{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":2,"content":"臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"等謹案：撼龍經一卷、疑龍經一卷、𦵏法倒","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890404910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"杖一卷，舊本題唐楊筠松撰。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890404910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"筠松不見于史","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890421294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"傳，惟陳振孫書録解題載其名氏。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890421294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"宋史藝文","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890437678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"志則但稱為楊救貧，亦不詳其始末。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890437678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"惟術家","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890454062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"相傳，以為筠松名益，贛州人，掌靈臺地理，官","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890454062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350747596350226466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"至金紫光禄大夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890454062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"廣明中，遇黄巢犯闕，竊禁","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890470446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"中玉函秘術以逃，後往來于處州。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890470446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"無稽之談，","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890486830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"盖不足盡信也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890486830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"然其書乃為世所盛傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890503214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"撼龍","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890519598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"經專言山壠落脈形勢，分貪狼、巨門、禄存、文","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890519598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"曲、廉貞、武曲、破軍、左輔、右弼九星，各為之説。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890519598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"疑龍經上篇言幹中尋枝，以𨵿局水口為主；","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890535982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"中篇論尋龍到頭，看面背朝迎之法；下篇論","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890535982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"結穴形勢，附以疑龍十問，以闡明其義。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890535982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"𦵏法","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890552366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350747630747648052"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"則專論㸃穴，有𠋣、盖、撞、黏諸説。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890552366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"倒杖分十二","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890568750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"條，即上説而引伸之，附二十四砂𦵏法，亦臨","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890568750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"穴時分寸毫𨤲之辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890568750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"案書録解題有疑龍經","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890585134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"一卷，辨龍經一卷，云：呉炎録以見遺，皆無名","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890585134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"氏。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890585134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"是此書在宋，並不題筠松所作。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890601518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"今本不知","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890617902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"何據而云然。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890617902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"其撼龍之即辨龍與否，亦無可","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890634286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"考證。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890634286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"然相傳已久，所論山川之性情、形勢，頗","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890650670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"能得其要領，流傳不廢，亦有以也。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890650670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"舊本有李","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890667054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7350747739208122431"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"國本註，併所附各圖，庸陋淺俗，了無可取。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890667054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"今","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890683438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"並加刋削，不使與本文相溷焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890683438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"乾隆四十六","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890699822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"年十月恭校上。","logicSentenceId":"7679050944890699822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"須彌山是天地骨，中鎮天地為巨物。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820179983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"如人背脊與項梁，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820196367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"生出四肢龍突兀。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820196367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"四肢分出四世界，南北東西為四𣲖。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820212751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"西北崆峒數萬程，東入三韓隔杳㝠。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820229135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有南龍入中國，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820245519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"胎宗孕祖來竒特。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820245519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"黄河九曲為大膓，川江屈曲為膀胱。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820261903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"分肢擘脉縱横去，氣血勾連逄水住。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820278287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"大為都邑帝王州，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820294671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"小為郡縣君公侯。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820294671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"其次偏方小鎮市，亦有富貴居其中。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820311055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469904900150"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"大率龍行自有真，星峯磊落是龍身。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820327439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"髙山須認星峯起，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820343823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"平地龍行别有名。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820343823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"峯以星名取其類，星辰下照山成形。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820360207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"龍神二字尋山脉，神是精神龍是質。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820376591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"莫道髙山方有龍，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820392975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"却來平地失真蹤。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820392975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"平地龍從髙脈發，髙起星峯低落穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820409359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"高山既認星峯起，平地兩傍尋水勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820425743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"两水夾處是真龍，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820442127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"枝葉周回中者是。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820442127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"莫令山反枝葉散，山若反兮水散漫。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820458511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"外山百里作羅城，此是平洋龍局叚。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820474895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"星峯頓伏落平去，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820491279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"外山隔水來相顧。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820491279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"平中仰掌似凹窠，隠隠微微立丘阜。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820507663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469904916534"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"傾從丘阜覔凹窠，或有勾夾如旋螺。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820524047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"勾夾是案螺是穴，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820540431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"水去明堂聚氣多。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820540431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"四傍遶䕶如城郭，水遶山還聚一窩。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820556815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"霜降水涸尋不見，春夏水髙龍背現。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820573199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"此是平洋看龍法，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820589583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"過處如絲或如線。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820589583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"髙水一寸即是山，低水一寸水回環。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820605967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"水纒便是山纒様，纒得真龍如仰掌。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820622351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"窠心掌裏或乳頭，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820638735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"端然有穴明天象。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820638735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"水遶山纒在平坡，逺有岡陵近有河。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820655119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"只愛山來抱身體，不愛水返去從他。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820671503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"水抱應知山來抱，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820687887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"水不抱兮山不到。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820687887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"莫道髙山龍易識，行到平洋失踪跡。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820704271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469904932918"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"藕斷絲連正好尋，退卸愈多愈有力。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820720655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"髙龍多下低處藏，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820737039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"四沒神機便尋得。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820737039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"祖宗父母數程遥，誤得時師皆不識。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820753423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"凡到平地莫問踪，只觀環遶是真龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820769807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"念得龍經無眼力，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820786191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"萬卷真藏也是空。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820786191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"北辰一星中天尊，上相上將居四垣。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820802575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙太乙明堂照，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820818959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢三台相後先。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820818959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"此星萬里不得一，此龍不許時人識。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820835343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"識得之時不用藏，留與皇朝鎮家國。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820851727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"請從垣外論九星，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820868111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"北斗星宫係幾名。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820868111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"貪巨武星并輔弼，禄文亷破地中行。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820884495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469904949302"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"九星人言有三吉，三吉之餘有輔弼。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820900879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"不知星曜定錙銖，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820917263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"祻福之門敎君識。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820917263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼頓起笋生峯，若是斜枝便不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820933647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"斜枝側頂為破靣，","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820950031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"尖而有脚號乗龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820950031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"脚下横拖為帯劒，文武功名從此辯。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820966415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"横看是頂側是峯，此是貪狼出陣龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679516750820982799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"側靣成峯身直去，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962590760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"不是為朝便不住。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962590760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"莫來此處認髙峯，道是玄武在其中。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962607144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有髙峯是玄武，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962623528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武落處四獸聚。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962623528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"聚處方為龍聚星，四獸不顧只成空。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962639912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469904965686"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡龍上莫尋穴，縱然有穴易歇滅。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962656296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"或為關峽似龍形，正身潛在峽中行。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962672680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"時師多向峽中覔，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962689064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"不識真龍斷續情。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962689064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼自有十二様，尖圓平直小為上。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962705448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"欹斜側巖倒破空，祻福輕重自不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962721832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"欹側似斜斜似側，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962738216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"平似乗龍側似直。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962738216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼似巨倒似空，空似虚巖即似石。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962754600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"問君來此如何觀，我道貪狼非一般。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962770984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"欹是崩崖破是折，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962787368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"斜是邊有邊不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962787368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"側是靣尖身直去，空是巖穴多玲瓏。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962803752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"倒是飛峯偏不正，七者未是貪狼龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962820136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"平地卓然頓起笋，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962836520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469904982070"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"此是尖狼本來性。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962836520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"圓無欹側四靣同，平若卧蠶在髙頂。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962852904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"直如决脊引繩來，小似筆頭挿髙塔。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962869288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"五者方為貪正形，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962885672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶祻福要詳明。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962885672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"火星要起廉貞位，生出貪狼由此勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962902056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"若見火星動熖時，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962918440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"看他踪跡落何處。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962918440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍不是尋常貴，生出貪狼向亦竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962934824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"火星若起廉貞位，落處須尋一百里。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962951208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"中有貪狼小小峯，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962967592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"有時回顧火星宫。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962967592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"世人只道貪狼好，不識廉貞是祖宗。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108962983976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼若非廉作祖，為官也不到三公。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963000360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"髙山頂上如平掌，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963016744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469904998454"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"中分細脉如蛇様。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963016744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"貴龍多是穿心出，富龍只從傍生上。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963033128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"髙山如帳後靣遮，帳裏微微似帯斜。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963049512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"𢃄舞下來如䑕尾，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963065896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"此是貪狼上嶺蛇。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963065896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"帯舞下來伸鶴頸，此是貪狼下嶺蛇。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963082280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"上嶺解生朱紫貴，下嶺須為朽腐家。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963098664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"大山特起小為貴，小山忽起大為勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963115048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"髙低大小斷續行，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963131432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"此是貪狼真骨氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963131432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵九星有種類，生子生孫巧相似。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963147816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"剝換方知骨氣真，剝換不真皆不是。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963164200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"一剝一換大生小，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963180584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"從大剝小最竒異。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963180584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"剝換退卸見真龍，小峯依舊貪狼起。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963196968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905014838"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"剝小如人換好裳，如蟬退殻蠶退筐。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963213352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"或從大山落低小，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963229736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"或從高峯落平洋。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963229736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"退卸剥換成幾段，十條九條亂了亂。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963246120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"中有一條𨚫是真，若是真時斷了斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963262504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"亂山回抱在靣前，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963278888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"不許一條出外邊。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963278888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"只有真龍在帳內，亂山在外却為纒。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963295272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍多從腰裏落，回轉餘枝作城廓。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963311656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"城廓彎𤨔生捍門，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963328040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"門外羅星當腰着。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963328040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"羅星要在羅城外，此與火星常作案。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963344424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"火星龍始有羅星，若是羅星不居內。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963360808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"居內名為抱養瘝，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963377192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"又為病跟墮胎山。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963377192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"羅星若生羅城口，城口皆為玉笋班。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963393576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905031222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"羅城恰似城墻勢，龍在城中聚真氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963409960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"羅星借在城闕間，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963426344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"時師喚作水口山。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963426344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"欲識羅星真妙訣，一邊枕水一邊田。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963442728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"田中有骨胍相連，或為頑石焦土間。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963459112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"此是羅星有餘氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963475496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"卓立為星在水邊。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963475496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"貪巨羅星方與尖，輔弼武曲員匾眠。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963491880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存廉貞多破碎，破軍尖破最為害。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963508264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"只有尖圓方匾星，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963524648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"此是羅星得正形。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963524648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然四靣皆是水，两山環合欝然青。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963541032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"羅星亦自有種類，浪説羅星在水邊。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963557416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門尊星性端荘，纔離祖宗即高昻。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963573800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"星峯自與衆星别，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963590184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905047606"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"不尖不圓其體方。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963590184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"髙處定為頓笏様，但是無脚生两傍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963606568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"如此星峯止一二，方岡之下如驅羊。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963622952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"方岡或如四角帳，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963639336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"帳中出帯似飛揚。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963639336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"飛揚要得穿帳去，帳中两角隨身張。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963655720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"枝葉不多關峽少，却有䕶衛隨身傍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963672104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"帯旌帯節來擁䕶，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963688488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"旌節之峯多是雙。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963688488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"更有刀劍同䕶送，刀劍送後前圓岡。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963704872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"離蹤斷處多失胍，抛梭馬跡蛛絲長。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963721256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"梭中自有絲不斷，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963737640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"蜂腰過處多趨蹌。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963737640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"自是此星性尊貴，䕶送此星來就體。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963754024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"每逄跌斷過處時，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963770408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905063990"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"两傍定有衣冠吏。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963770408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"衣冠之吏似圓峯，两傍有脚衛真龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963786792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"若是獨行無䕶衛，定作神祠佛道宫。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963803176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"平行穿珠行數里，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963819560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然又作方峯起。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963819560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"方峯直去如橋扛，背長頗類平尖貪。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963835944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"平尖貪狼如一字，生在山頂如卧蠶。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963852328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲倒從身中出，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963868712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼直去如僧叅。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963868712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"夾輔䕶龍次第列，正龍在內左右凾。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963885096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍住處無髙壠，間生窩穴隱深潭。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963901480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"獨在山峽中間者，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963917864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"穴落髙岡似草庵。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963917864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"四圍要髙來朝䕶，前案朝迎亦髙舞。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963934248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"却作髙穴似人形，按歛端嚴似真武。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963950632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905080374"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍若行三十里，內起方峯止三四。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963967016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"峯峯端正方與長，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963983400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"不肯欹斜失尊體。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963983400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"峯上忽然生摺痕，此與廉貞何以異。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108963999784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"凡起星辰不許斜，更嫌生脚照他家。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964016168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"端峯若生四花穴，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964032552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"花穴端嚴要君别。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964032552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍直去向前行，四向謾成龍虎穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964048936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"此是武曲鉗峽來，間氣來此偶生峽。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964065320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍誤了幾多人，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964081704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"定來此處説真形。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964081704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"要説四花穿心過，但看䕶衛不曾停。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964098088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"尊星自有尊星體，方正為屏將相位。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964114472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門行龍少鬼刼，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964130856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"葢緣两傍多羅列。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964130856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"水界分處夾龍行，不肯單行走空缺。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964147240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905096758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"水界分及亂生枝，枝葉雖多夾水隨。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964163624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"䕶龍亦自有背靣，","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964180008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"背後如壁靣平夷。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964180008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"平夷便是貼龍體，龍過之時形怪異。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964196392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"不起尖圓即馬旗，攢劒繙龍歸此地。","logicSentenceId":"7679517108964212776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"䕶衛纒遶如打團，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504187919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"重重包裹外山歸。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504187919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"至令巨門少關峽，䕶送無容左右離。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504204303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂斷定無斜㵼，横案重重拜舞低。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504220687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"平貪覆巨圓武曲，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504237071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"尖圓方整不能齊。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504237071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"三星尖圓方整處，向此辯别無狐疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504253455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"識龍須識辨疑處，識得真龍是聖師。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504269839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存之形如頓鼓，下生有脚如瓜瓠。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504286223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"瓜瓠頭前有小峯，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504302607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905113142"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"此是禄存𢃄禄處。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504302607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"大如螃蠏小蜘蛛，此是禄存𢃄殺處。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504318991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"殺中若有横磨歛，此是權星先出武。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504335375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"大龍大峽百十程，寶殿龍樓去無數。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504351759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":259,"lineType":2,"content":"峽口㣲平曰殿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"忽履仁等","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504368143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"入長垣，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504368143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":261,"lineType":2,"content":"長垣如城。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"萬仞不圍君莫顧。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504368143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"癡師偷眼傍睥晲，曉者","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504384527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"黙然佯不睹。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504384527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"若然尖脚亂如茅，喚作蚩尤旗爪距。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504400911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":263,"lineType":2,"content":"天上有蚩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":265,"lineType":2,"content":"尤旗星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"小圓𢃄禄圍本身。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504417295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"將相公侯出方虎。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504433679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵星辰嫌破碎，不抱本身多作怪。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504450063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"端正龍神須無破，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504466447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"醜惡龍神多破敗。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504466447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"怪形異穴出凶豪，殺戮平民終大壊。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504482831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905129526"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"草頭作亂因此山，赤族誅夷償命債。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504499215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"只縁龍上有欃槍，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504515599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"賊旗倒仄非旌幢。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504515599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"旌幢對對端正立，獨立欹仄名欃槍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504531983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"頓鼓微方似武曲，武曲端正下無足。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504548367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"有足周圍真禄存，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504564751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"圓盡方為武曲尊。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504564751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"龍家最要仔細辨，疑似亂真分背靣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504581135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"背似靣非豈有真，此是禄存大移轉。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504597519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"凹處是靣凸是背，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504613903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"作穴分金過如線。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504613903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"凡看星辰看轉移，轉移須敎母顧兒。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504630287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"枝分𣲖别有真種，忽作瓜蔓無東西。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504646671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"十里半程無岡嶺，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504663055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"平陽砂磧烟塵迷。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504663055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"到處君須看水勢，水勢莫問江與溪。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504679439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905145910"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"只要两源相夾出，交瑣外結重重圍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504695823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存好處落平洋，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504712207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"大作方州小鎮縣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504712207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"坪中時復亂石生，或起横山或梭靣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504728591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"此處或有輔弼形，輔弼無枝禄生辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504744975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"禄是帝車第二星，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504761359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"也主為文也主兵。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504761359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"274","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"九星行龍皆要禄，最要夾貪兼巨軸。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504777743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"或從武曲左右起，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504794127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"此等貴龍看不足。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504794127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢此星逺尋穴，莫向髙山尋促局。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504810511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇九星相夾行，只分有足并無足。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504826895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"燕雲下嶺出九關，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504843279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"中帯禄存三吉山。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504843279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"髙山峽裏多尖秀，也有圓禄生孱岩。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504859663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905162294"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"君看山須分種類，亂指横山作正班。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504876047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"禄破二星形無數，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504892431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"也有正形落低處。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504892431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"也有低形上壠頭，雜亂分形君莫誤，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504908815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"形在髙嶺為髙形。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504908815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"山頂上生禄存星。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504925199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"形在平洋山卓立，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504941583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"頂矮脚手亦横平。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504941583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"頂上生形頂必正，平地生形脚亂行。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504957967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"請君看我細排列，祻福皆從龍上生。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504974351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"第一禄存如頓鼓，脚手對對隨身去。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522504990735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"平行有脚如劒芒，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505007119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"旌節幡幢排次序。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505007119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"此等星辰出大江，中有小貪并小巨。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505023503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"輔弼侍從左右生，隔岸山河逺相顧。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505039887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"此是龍身作州縣，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505056271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905178678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"雄據十州并一路。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505056271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然諸山作垣局，更求吉水為門户。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505072655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"若得吉水為門户，萬水千山不須做。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505089039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"第二禄存如覆釡，脚尖如㦸周回布。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505105423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"有脚方為真禄存，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505121807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"無脚方為禄堆巨。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505121807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"此星定是有威權，白手成家積巨富。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505138191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"第三禄存鶴爪布，两短中長龍出露。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505154575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"出露定為低小形，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505170959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"隠隠前行忽蹲踞。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505170959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"有穴必生龍虎巧，醜陋穴形龍不住。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505187343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"第四禄存肋扇具，脚手又似扛絲勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505203727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍只好結神壇，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505220111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"别有星峯生秀氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505220111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905195062"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"第五禄存如懸鶉，破碎箕帚摺無數。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505236495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"此星便是平行星，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505252879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"星平生枝自頂分。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505252879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍只去平中作，橈棹回來斬關做，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505269263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"髙山大峽開三路。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505269263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"第六禄存落平洋，勢如巨浪横開張。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505285647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"他星亦有落平者，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505302031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"此星平地亦飛揚。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505302031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"脚擺時復生巨石，石色只是黑與黄。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505318415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"两傍請看隨龍峽，長短大小宜推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505334799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"䕶龍轉時看他落，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505351183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"落處當隨水斟酌。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505351183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"右轉皆右不參差，左轉皆左無駁雜。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505367567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"朝迎指正真穴形，左右髙低君莫錯。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505383951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存鬼形如披髪，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505400335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905211446"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"雖曰衆多勢如掠。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505400335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"第七禄存如長蛇，左右無䕶無攔遮。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505416719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍目作貴龍從，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505433103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"枕在水邊自横斜。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505433103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"第八禄存在髙頂，如載兠鍪有肩領。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505449487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"漸低漸小去作穴，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505465871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"定作窩鉗極端正。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505465871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍號為八貴龍，捉穴真時最昌盛。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505482255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"第九禄存如落花，片片段段水夾砂。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505498639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"不作蛟潭為鬼穴，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505515023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"定作羅星水口遮。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505515023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"342","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"天下山山有禄存，或凶或吉要君分。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505531407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"莫道禄存全不善，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505547791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905227830"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"大為將相公侯門。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505547791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"要知五嶽真龍落，半是禄破相參錯。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505564175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"大行頂上馬耳峯，禄存身上貪狼龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505580559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"泰山頂上有石觀，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505596943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"上有月𠅘髙一半。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505596943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"此是禄存上有貪，如此髙峯孰能判。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505613327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"海中洲渚亦有山，君如論脈應難言。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505629711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"不知地脉連中國，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505646095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"逺出山形在海間。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505646095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"集出青齊為東岳，過盡平陽大江壑。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505662479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"地絡連延氣勢生，澗水止龍君莫錯。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505678863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"我觀破禄滿天下，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505695247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"九星分𠮓無識者。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505695247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"君如識得禄存星，珍寳連城貴無價。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505711631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"文曲正形蛇行様，若作淫邪如撒網。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505728015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"此星柔順最髙情，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505744399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905244214"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"形神恰似生鱔様。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505744399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"問君如何生此山，定出廉真絶體上。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505760783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"問君如何尋絶體，本宫山上敗絶氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505777167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"問君如何尋本宫，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505793551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"寶殿之下初出龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505793551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"認得星峯初出靣，看得何星細推辦。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522505809935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"九星皆挾文曲行，若無文曲星無變。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579685376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"𠮓星便看何星多，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579701760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"多者為主分惡善。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579701760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"文曲星柔最易見，每遇旺方生側靣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579718144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"側靣成峯身直行，直去多如絲雜線。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579734528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"此星山骨少星峯，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579750912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"若有星峯輔弼同。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579750912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"平地蛇行最為吉，半頂娥眉最得力。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579767296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"若有此星連接生，女作宫𡣕后妃職。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579783680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"男家因婦得官班，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579800064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905260598"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"又得資財并美色。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579800064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"凡起星峯必有情，自然連接左右生。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579816448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"若是無峯如鱔様，死龍散漫空縱横。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579832832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"縱饒住處有穴形，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579849216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"社壇神廟血食腥。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579849216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"若是作墳并建宅，女挿花枝逐客行。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579865600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"男人破家因酒色，女人內亂公訟庭。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579881984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"𠮓出瘵癆鬼怪病，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579898368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"令人冷退絶人丁。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579898368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"困龍坪下數十里，忽然卓立星峯起。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579914752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"左右前後忽逢迎，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579931136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"貪巨武輔取次生。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579931136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"只得一峯龍便活，娥眉也𠮓輔弼形。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579947520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"平行雖云𠮓輔弼，只是低平少威力。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579963904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"若得尊星生一峯，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579980288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905276982"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"便使柔星為長雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579980288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"男人端貌取科第，女人主家權勝翁。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522579996672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵尋龍少全格，雜出星峯多𠮓易。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580013056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"弼星似巨輔似文，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580029440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"長短髙低細辨識。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580029440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"莫道凶龍不可裁，也有凶龍起家國，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580045824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"葢縁未識間星龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580045824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"貪中有廉文有弼，武有破軍間斷生，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580062208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存或有巨武力。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580062208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"十里之中卓一峰，小者成大弱成雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580078592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"此星龍家間星法，大頓小伏為真踪。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580094976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"一山便斷為一代，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580111360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"看在何代生間斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580111360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"便向此星定富貴，困弱生旺隨星峰。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580127744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"困弱之龍無氣力，死鱔烟炮入砂礫。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580144128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"千里百里無從山，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580160512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905293366"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"獨自單行少收拾。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580160512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"君如識得間星龍，到處郷村可尋覔。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580176896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"龍非久逺少全氣，易盛易衰非人力。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580193280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"廉貞如何號獨火，此星得形最髙大。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580209664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"髙山頂上石嵯峨，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580226048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"傘摺犂頭裂絲破。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580226048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"只縁尖熖聳天庭，其性炎炎號火星。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580242432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"起作龍樓并寶殿，貪巨武曲因此生。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580258816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"古人深識廉貞體，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580275200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"喚作紅旗并曜氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580275200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"此星威烈屬陽精，髙熖赤黑峯頭起。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580291584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"髙尖是樓平是殿，請君來此細推辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580307968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"亂峯頂上亂石間，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580324352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"此處名為聚講山。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580324352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"聚講既成即分去，分宗拜祖迢迢路。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580340736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905309750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"尋踪尋跡更尋兒，龍來此處最堪疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580357120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"却來此處横生嶂，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580373504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"形如帳幕開張様。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580373504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"二重入帳一重出，四重五重如巨浪。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580389888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"嶂中有線穿心行，帳不穿心不入相。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580406272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"帳幕多時貴亦多，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580422656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"一重只是富豪様。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580422656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"两帳两幕是真龍，帳裏貴人最為上。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580439040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"帳中隠隠仙帯飛，𢃄舞低垂主興旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580455424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"天關地軸两邊迎，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580471808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"異石龜蛇過處往。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580471808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"髙山頂上有池水，两邊夾得真龍行。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580488192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"問君髙頂何生水，此是真龍頂上氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580504576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"樓殿之上水泉生，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580520960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"水還兩處两邊迎。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580520960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍却向泉中過，也有單池在傍抱。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580537344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905326134"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"單池終不及两池，池若傾崩反生祻。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580553728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"池平两水夾又清，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580570112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"此處名為天漢星。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580570112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"天漢天潢入閣道，此星入相居天庭。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580586496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"更有衛龍在髙頂，水貼龍身入深井。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580602880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"更無水出可追尋，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580619264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"或有蒙泉如小鏡。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580619264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"看他辭樓并下殿，出帳聳起生何形。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580635648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"應星生處别立形，此是分枝劈脉證。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580652032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"祖宗分了分兄弟，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580668416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"來此分貪識真性。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580668416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"分貪之處莫令差，差謬一毫千里逈。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580684800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"笋峯貪狼縱横計，鍾釡枕梭武輔弼。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580701184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"方峯是為巨門程，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580717568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"最要來辨嫡庶行。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580717568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"嫡庶不失出帳形，便是龍家五吉星。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580733952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905342518"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"廉貞惡石衆所畏，不曉真陽火裏精。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580750336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍多向南方落，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580766720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"北上衆山驚錯愕。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580766720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"低頭歛袵山朝來，莫向他方妄叅錯。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580783104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"凡是星峯皆有石，若是土山全無力。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580799488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"廉貞獨火氣衝天，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580815872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"石骨稜層平處覔。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580815872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"廉貞不生吉星峯，定隔江河作應龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580832256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"朝迎必應數百里，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580848640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"逺望鼓角聲鼕鼕。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580848640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"凡見廉貞髙聳石，便上頂頭看逺跡。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580865024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"細認真龍此處生，華葢穿心正龍出。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580881408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍最貴難尋覔，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580897792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"五吉要聳華葢出。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580897792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"此等真龍不易逢，華葢三峯品字立。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580914176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905358902"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"两肩分作两䕶龍，此是兄弟同祖宗。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580930560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟便為纒䕶龍，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580946944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"前迎後送生雌雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580946944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"雌若為龍雄作應，雄若為龍雌聽","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580963328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"命。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580963328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"問君如何辨雌雄，髙低肥瘠瘦不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580979712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"低肥為雌雄髙","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580996096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"瘠，只求此處識踪跡。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522580996096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"隨龍身上有正峯，時作星峯拜祖宗。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581012480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"但看䕶送似回龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581028864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"又有迎龍如虎踞，隨龍山水皆朝揖，狐疑來處失踪跡。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581045248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"水口重重生異石，定有羅星當水立。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581061632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"羅星外靣有山關，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581078016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"上生下生細尋覔，葢縁羅星有真假，真假天然非人力。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581078016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905375286"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"羅星旁水便生石，羅星端正最髙職。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581094400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
