{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"廉貞多生顧祖龍，祖龍逺逺是朝峯。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581110784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"更有鬼脚回顧處，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581127168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"䕶送須生十數里。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581127168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"送龍之山短有後，抱山不抱左右手。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581143552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"纒龍纒過龍虎前，三重五重福延綿。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581159936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"纒多不許外山走，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581176320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"那堪長逺作水口。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581176320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"䕶送托龍若十全，富貴雙全真罕有。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581192704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"尋龍千萬看纒山，一重纒是一重關。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581209088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"關門若有千重鎖，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581225472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"定有王侯居此間。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581225472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"廉貞已具貪狼內，更述此篇為詳載。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581241856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"有人曉得紅旗星，逺有威權近凶怪。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581258240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"權星斬砍得自由，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581274624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905391670"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"不統兵權不肯休。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581274624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇廉貞不起石，脚下也須生石壁。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581291008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"石壁是背靣是平，平處尋龍出踪跡。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522581307392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"貪巨武輔弼星行，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663571490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"出身生處是真星。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663571490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"博龍換處有九叚，此是公侯將相庭。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663587874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"紅旗氣雄威武在，行兵出師駭妖怪。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663604258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"權星威福得自專，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663620642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"縱入文堦亦武威。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663620642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"廉良一𠮓貪巨武，文武全才登宰輔。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663637026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"廉貞不作𠮓換星，潔身亂倫弑君父。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663653410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲星峯覆鍾釡，鍾釡之形有何故。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663669794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"鍾髙釜矮事不同，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663686178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"髙即為武矮為輔。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663686178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"二者雖然皆吉星，大小不容有差互。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663702562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905408054"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲端嚴富貴牢，輔弼隨龍厚薄取。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663718946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍若行五六程，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663735330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"臨落之時剝輔星。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663735330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"如梭如印如皎月，三三两两牽聮行。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663751714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"前關後峽相引從，峽若多時龍猛勇。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663768098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"博到輔星三四重，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663784482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"仔細來此認龍踪。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663784482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"貪巨若無輔弼落，高嶺如何住得龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663800866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然輔弼是入穴，作穴隨形又不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663817250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"穴隨土峯作鉗乳，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663833634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"形神大小隨龍宗。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663833634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"圓龍忽然長拖脚，恐是鬼龍如覆杓。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663850018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"覆箕仰掌是鬼龍，莫來此處失真踪。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663866402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"請君細認前頭穴，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663882786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"莫使參前失後空。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663882786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905424438"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"問君何以知我落？","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663899170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"看他尾後圓峯作。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663915554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"問君知我如何行，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663931938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"尾星揺動不曾停。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663931938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"前官後鬼須細辨，鬼尅我身居後靣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663948322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"官星尅我在前朝，此是龍家官鬼現。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663964706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍落處隂陽亂，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663981090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"五行官鬼無相戰。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663981090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"水龍博到火龍出，鬼在後頭官出面。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522663997474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"坎山來龍作午丁，𨚫把地羅差使轉。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664013858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"此是隂陽雜五行，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664030242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"不是龍家官鬼辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664030242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"龍家不要論五行，且從龍看分脈。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664046626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"上","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664063010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"龍奪胍時是鬼氣，鬼氣不歸龍上行。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664063010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵正龍無鬼山，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664079394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"有鬼不出半里間。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664079394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"横龍出穴必有鬼，送跳翻身穴後環。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664095778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905440822"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼山若長奪我氣，鬼短貼身如抱攔。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664112162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"問君如何謂之鬼？","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664128546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"主山背後撑者是。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664144930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"分枝劈脉不回頭，奪我正身少全氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664161314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍穴後如有鬼，山短枝多為雉尾。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664177698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"此是真龍穴後星，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664194082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰亦有尖圓體。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664194082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"正龍穴後若有鬼，隻隻回頭來䕶衛。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664210466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"若不回頭衛本身，此是空亡歇滅地。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664226850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"問君何者是空亡，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664243234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"穴後捲空仰瓦勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664243234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"便從鬼上細尋覔，鬼山星峯少收拾。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664259618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍身上䕶衛多，山山多情來拱揖。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664276002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"䕶衛貼體不敢離，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664292386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"中有泉池暗流入。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664292386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"要識真龍鬼山短，縁有纒龍在後股。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664308770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905457206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"既有纒龍貼䕶身，不許鬼山空散漫。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664325154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼山直去投江海，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664341538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍氣絶散漫多。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664341538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"如㦸如矛亂走去，包裹無由奈他何。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664357922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"龍若無纒又無送，縱有真龍不堪用。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664374306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"䕶纒多愛到穴前，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664390690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"三重五重福綿延。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664390690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"一重䕶衛一代富，䕶衛十里宰相地。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664407074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"两重亦作典磚城，一重只出丞簿尉。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664423458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼山亦自有真形，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664439842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"形隨三吉輔弼類。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664439842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"九星皆有鬼形様，不類本身不入相。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664456226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼鬼星必尖小，武曲鬼星枝葉少。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664472610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"多作圓峯覆杓形，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664488994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"撑住在後最為妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664488994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門墜珠玉枕形，貪作天梯背後生。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664505378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905473590"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"一層一級漸低小，雖然有脚無横行。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664521762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門多為小横嶺，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664538146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"托後如屏玉几正。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664538146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"弼星作鬼如圍屏，或從龍虎後橫生。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664554530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"横生瓜瓠抱穴後，金斗玉印盤龍形。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664570914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"輔星多為獨節鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664587298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"三對平如冩王字。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664587298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"三對两對相並行，曲轉䕶身皆有意。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664603682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"廉文破禄本是鬼，不必問他穴後尾。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664620066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"破禄廉文多作關，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664636450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"近關太濶為散關。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664636450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"關門是局有大小，破禄三星多外攔。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664652834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"禄星無禄作神壇，破星不破為近關。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664669218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"善論大地論關局，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664685602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"關局大小水口山。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664685602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼山作向横龍作正龍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664701986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"多是平地落","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664718370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905489974"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"平地勢如蜈蚣行，𨚫長便如橈棹形。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664718370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"停棹向前穴即近，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664734754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"發棹向後龍未停。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664734754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"橈棹向後忽峯起，定有真龍居此地。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664751138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"只看䕶托回轉時，朝揖在前拜真氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664767522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵九星皆有鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664783906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"相類相如各有四。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664783906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"四九三十六鬼形，識鬼便是識真精。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664800290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"問君如何謂之官，朝山背後逆拖山。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664816674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"此是朝山有餘氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664833058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"與我穴後鬼一般。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664833058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"官星在前鬼在後，官要回頭鬼要就。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664849442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"官不回頭鬼不就，只是虚抱無落首。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664865826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"龍穴背後有衣裙，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664882210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"此是關闌多舞袖。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664882210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然有袖穴不見，官不離鄉任何愛。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664898594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905506358"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"真氣聚處看明堂，明堂裏靣要平陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664914978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂裏靣停豬水，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664931362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"第一寛平始為貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664931362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"側裂傾堆撞射身，急㵼崩騰非吉地。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664947746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"請君未斷左右山，先向明堂觀水勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664964130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂亦有如鍋底，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664980514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"横號金船龍虎裏。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664980514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"直號天心曲御堦，馬蹄直兮有曲勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522664996898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂要似蓮花水，盪歸左位長公起，盪歸右處小公興，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665013282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"若居中心諸位貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665013282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵明堂横為貴，其次之玄關鎻是。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665029666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"蕩蕩直去不回頭，雖似御堦非吉地。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665046050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂要如衣領會，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665062434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"左紐右䙡方為貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665062434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"或是曰隴與山脚，如此關闌真可喜。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665078818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905522742"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然横前無關鎻，地刼風吹非吉利。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665095202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"請君來此細消詳，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665111586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"更分前官并後鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665111586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"左脇生來搢笏様，右脇生來魚袋形。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665127970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"方長為象短為水，小巧是金肥是銀。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665144354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"看此様形臨局勢，","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665160738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"中間乳穴是為真。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665160738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"652","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"賜𢃄鬼形如瓜瓠，二條連移左轉去，回頭貼來侍從官。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665177122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"前案横交金玉盤。","logicSentenceId":"7679517522665193506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"玉盤賜将金盤相。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141722152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"左右在人心眼上，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141738536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"重數如多賜亦多。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141738536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"一重數是金屏帯，二重是屏三金帯。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141754920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"横轉穴前官轉大，子孫三代垂魚袋。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141771304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"右上三魚虎身外，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141787688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905539126"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"三代子孫賜金帯。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141787688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"三重横盤龍外生，四重即是賜金玉。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141804072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"重數如多福最深，此是龍家賜帯鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141820456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"莫將龍向左邊臨，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141836840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"玉几方屏武曲形，身後是几几外屏。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141836840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"几屏須要問先後，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141853224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"未有屏先几後生。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141853224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"几屏如在後頭托，此是公侯將相庭。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141869608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"破軍星峯如走旗，前頭髙卓尾後低。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141885992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"两傍失險落坑䧟，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141902376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"壁立反裂形傾欹。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141902376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"不知此星出六府，上有三台逺為祖。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141918760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"然後生出六曜星，貪巨禄文廉武輔。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141935144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"三台星辰號三階，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141951528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"六星两两魚眼挨。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141951528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"雙尖雙圓如貪巨，𨚫在絶頂雙安排。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141967912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905555510"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"雙尖定出貪狼去，雙圓生出武曲來。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523141984296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"上台中台下台出，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142000680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"行到六府文昌臺。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142000680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"文昌六星如偃月，穿星六星似環玦。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142017064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"平頃上頭生六星，六處微堆作凹凸。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142033448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"凹中微起似六星，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142049832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"生出九星若排列。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142049832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"685","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"破軍皆受九星變，逐位生峯形象現。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142066216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"山形在地水在天，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142082600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"真氣下感祻福騐。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142082600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"尊星頓起真形了，枝葉皆是禄存占。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142098984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"尊星雖云有三吉，三吉之餘有輔弼。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142115368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"不知三吉不常生，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142131752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"有處觀來無一實。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142131752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"葢縁不識破軍星，星説走旗拖尾出。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142148136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905571894"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"走旗拖尾是真形，若出尊星形𠮓生。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142164520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"與君細論破軍體，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142180904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"逐一隨星種類名。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142180904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼破軍如頓起，一層一級名天梯。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142197288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"頂尖衝前有巖穴，伸頂猶如雞作啼。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142213672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"頂頭有帯下巖去，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142230056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"引到平處如蛛絲。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142230056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"欲斷不斷馬跡過，東西有顯梭中絲。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142246440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"三吉之星總如此，此處名為吉破地。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142262824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"過坪過水皆如是，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142279208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"定有泉塘两夾隨，貪下破軍巨門去，去為垣局不須疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142279208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門破軍裂十字，頂上微圓欹側取。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142295592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"勢如啄木上髙枝，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142311976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":773,"lineType":1,"content":"直上髙崖石觜露。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142311976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":773,"lineType":1,"content":"此星出龍生鼎足，爪甲巉巖若雞距。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142328360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905588278"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍富貴生王侯，五換六移出宰輔。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142344744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存破軍在平頂，两脇蛇行肋微露。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142361128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"前如大木倒平洋，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142377512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"生幹生枝葉無數。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142377512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"葉中生出嫩枝條，又作髙峯下平地。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142393896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"當知為穴亦不逺，䕶送不來作神宇。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142410280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"716","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲破如破橱櫃，身形臃脹崩形勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142426664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"前頭走出雞伸頸，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142443048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"嶺上下來如象鼻。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142443048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"一髙一下脚不尖，作穴乳頭出富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142459432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"破軍廉貞髙崔嵬，水流關峽聲如雷。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142475816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"輔星破軍如幞頭，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142492200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"两傍有脚如抛毬。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142492200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"弼星破軍如鯉躍，行到平中一時卓。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142508584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905604662"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"三三两两平中行，直出身來横布脚。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142524968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"為神為廟為富貴，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142541352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"只看纒䕶細斟酌。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142541352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"纒多便是富貴龍，纒少只為鐘鼓閣。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142557736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"九星皆有破禄文，三吉之形輔弼尊。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142574120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"平行穿珠巨貪禄，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142590504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"䦨掉尖拖是破軍。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142590504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星之下無不吉，凶星之下凶所存。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142606888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"况是凶龍不為穴，只是閒行引過身。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142623272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"縱然有穴必是假，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142639656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"假穴如何保久存。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142639656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"時師只來尋龍胍，來此峽內空低蹲。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142656040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"便指纒䕶為真氣，或有逺秀出他村。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142672424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"便説朝山朝水好，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142688808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"下了凶事自入門。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142688808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"只縁不識真龍出，前靣必出星辰尊。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142705192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905621046"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"尊星沾了死龍骨，換了破軍廉禄文。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142721576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"破軍忽然横開張，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142737960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"帳裏戈旗出生旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142737960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍出作將軍形，前遇溪流為甲仗。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142754344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"破禄形象最為多，枝蔓懸延氣少平。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142770728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"不為尖刀即劒戟，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142787112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"不作蛇行即擲梭。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142787112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"出逄六秀方位上，上與六氣横天河。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142803496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"六氣𠮓而生六秀，凶星到此亦消磨。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142819880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"凶星消磨生吉氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142836264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"定有星辰巨浪波。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142836264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"此是神仙絶妙法，不比尋常格地羅。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142852648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"與君畧舉大形勢，舉目一望皆江河。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142869032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"天下江山幾萬重，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142885416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"我見破軍到處是。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142885416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存文曲輔弼星，低小山形總相類。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142901800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905637430"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"只有髙山形象殊，畧舉大綱與君議。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142918184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"崑崙山脚出闐顔，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142934568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"隻隻脚是破軍山。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142934568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"連綿走出澣海北，風俗强悍人麄頑。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142950952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"生兒三歲學騎射，骨鯁剛方是此間。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142967336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"山來隴右尖如削，盡","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142983720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"是狼峯更髙卓。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523142983720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"此處如何不出文，只為峯多反成濁。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143000104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"髙","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143016488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"山大隴峯多尖，不似平原一錐卓。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143016488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"行行退卸大散關，百","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143032872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"二山河在彼間。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143032872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"大纒大䕶到函谷，水出黄河如闕環。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143049256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"低","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143065640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"平漸漸出熊耳，萬里平陽漸漸低。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143065640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"大梁形勢亦無山，到","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143082024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"此尋龍何處是。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143082024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"識得星峯是等間，平處尋龍最是難。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143098408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143114792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905653814"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"無江流與淮水，渺渺茫茫不見山。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143114792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"河流冲决山斷絶，又","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143131176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"無石骨又無脉。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143131176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"君若到彼説星峯，一句不容三寸舌。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143147560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"黄","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143163944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"河在北大江南，两水夾行勢不絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143163944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"行到背脊忽起峯，兖","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143180328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"州東岳挿天雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143180328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"分技劈脉鍾靈氣，聖賢多在魯邦中。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143196712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"自","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143213096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"古英雄出西北，西北龍神少人識。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143213096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微垣局太微宫，天","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143229480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"市天苑太行東。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143229480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"南龍髙枝過總頂，黑鐡二山雪峯盛。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143245864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"分","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143262248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"出秦川及漢川，五嶺分星入桂連。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143262248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"山行有斷脉不斷，直","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143278632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"至江隂大海邊。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143278632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"海門旺氣連閩越，南水两夾相交纒。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143295016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143311400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905670198"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"是海門南脉絡，貨財文武相交錯。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143311400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"何處是貪何處文，何","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143327784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"處辨認武曲尊。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143327784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"尋龍望氣先尋脉，雲霧多生是龍脊。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523143344168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"春","logicSentenceId":"7679517523233996840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"夏之交與二分，夜望雲霓生處覔。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523233996840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"雲霓先生絶髙頂，此","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234013224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"是龍樓寶殿定。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234013224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"大脊微微雲自生，霧氣如嵐反難證。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234029608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"生","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234045992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"尋霧氣識正龍，却是枝龍觀逺應。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234045992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"此是神仙尋地法，百","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234062376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"里羅城不為逺。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234062376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"知此然後論九星，要識九星觀正形。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234078760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"因","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234095144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"就正龍行脚處，認取破禄中間行。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234095144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"天下山山有破禄，破","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234111528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"禄交横有地軸。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234111528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存無禄只為關，破軍不破只為䦨。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234127912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"關","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234144296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905686582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"闌之山作水口，必有羅星在水間。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234144296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"大河之中有砥柱，四","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234160680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"川之口生灔澦。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234160680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"大姑小姑彭蠡前，採石金山作門户。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523234177064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":8 {"lines":[{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"弼星本來無正形，形隨八曜髙低生。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335200768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"要識弼星正形處，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335217152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"八星斷處隠藏行。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335217152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"隠藏是形名隠曜，此是弼星最要妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335233536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"抛梭馬跡線如絲，蜘蛛過水上灘魚。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335249920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"驚蛇入草失行跡，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335266304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"斷脉斷跡尋來無脉是尊名。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335266304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"右弼星，左右隨龍身上行。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335282688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":1079,"lineType":1,"content":"行龍之時有輔弼，𠮓換隨龍看踪跡。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335299072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":1079,"lineType":1,"content":"君如識得右弼星，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335315456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469905866806"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"毎到垣中多失跡。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335315456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"博龍失脉失跡時，地上朱絃琴背覔。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335331840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"若識弼星隠曜宫，處處觀來皆是吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335348224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"此星多吉少傍凶，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335364608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"葢為藏形本無實。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335364608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"藏形之時神殺藏，却是地中暗來脉。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335380992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"此地平陽千百程，不然彼處却是弼。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335397376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"坪中還有水流坡，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335413760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"髙水一寸即是阿。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335413760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"只為時師眼力淺，到彼茫然無奈何。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335430144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"便云無處尋踪跡，直到有山方認得。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335446528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"如此之人豈可言，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335462912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"有穴在坪原自失。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335462912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"只來山上覔龍虎，又要圓頭始云吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335479296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":1097,"lineType":1,"content":"不知山穹落平去，穴在坪中貴無敵。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335495680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":1097,"lineType":1,"content":"癡師悞了幾多人，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335512064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469946187819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"又道𦵏埋畏卑濕。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335512064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"不知穴在水中者，如此難憑山泉濕。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335528448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"葢縁水漲在中央，水退即同乾地力。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335544832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"且如两淮平似掌，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335561216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"也有州軍落巢瀝。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335561216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"也有英雄在彼中，豈無墳墓與宫室。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335577600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"只将水注與水流，两水夾流是龍脊。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335593984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"非惟弼曜在其中，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335610368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"八曜入坪皆有蹤。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335610368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"前篇有時説平處，平裏貪狼皆一同。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335626752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"時師識盡真龍胍，方知富貴與豐隆。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335643136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼作穴是乳頭，巨門作穴窩中求。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335659520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲作穴釵鉗覔，","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335675904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":1115,"lineType":1,"content":"禄廉梳齒犁鐴頭。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335675904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":1115,"lineType":1,"content":"文曲穴來坪裏作，髙處亦是掌心","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335692288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852469946204203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"落。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335692288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"破軍作穴似戈矛，两傍左右手皆收。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335708672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"定有两山皆䕶","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335725056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"衛，不然一水過横流。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335725056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"輔星正穴燕巢仰，若在髙山掛燈","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335741440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"様。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335741440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"落在低平是雞巢，縱有圓頭亦凹象。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335757824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"此是博換尋星","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335774208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"穴，尋穴隨龍細辨别。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335774208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"龍若真兮穴亦真，龍不真兮少真","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335790592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335790592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"尋龍雖易裁穴難，只為時人昧剝山。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335806976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"剝龍換骨星𠮓","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335823360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"易，識得疑龍穴不難。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335823360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"古人望龍知正穴，葢将失龍尋換","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335839744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"節。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335839744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"識得龍家換骨星，富貴令人無歇滅。","logicSentenceId":"7679517523335856128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
