{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"疑龍何處最難疑，尋得星峰𨚫是枝。","logicSentenceId":"7666016351673565230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"關峽從行并䕶托，","logicSentenceId":"7666016351673581614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"矗矗槍旗左右隨。","logicSentenceId":"7666016351673581614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"幹上星峰金不作，星峰龍法近虚詞。","logicSentenceId":"7666016351673597998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"與君少釋狐疑事，幹上尋龍真可據。","logicSentenceId":"7666016351673614382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"幹龍長逺去無窮，","logicSentenceId":"7666016351673630766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"行到中間陽氣聚。","logicSentenceId":"7666016351673630766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"靣前山水又可愛，背後䕶龍皆反背。","logicSentenceId":"7666016351673647150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"君如就此問疑龍，此是幹龍迎送隊。","logicSentenceId":"7666016351673663534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如齎糧適千里，","logicSentenceId":"7666016351673679918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625579054"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"豈無頓宿分內外。","logicSentenceId":"7666016351673679918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"龍行長逺去茫茫，定有叅隨部位長。","logicSentenceId":"7666016351673696302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"凡有好山為幹去，枝龍盡處有旗鎗。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032784411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"旗鎗也是星峰作，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032800795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"圓浄尖方髙更卓。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032800795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"就中尋穴穴却無，幹去未休枝早落。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032817179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"枝龍身上亦可裁，半是虚花半是胎。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032833563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"若是虚花無朝應，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032849947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"若是結實䕶送回。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032849947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"䕶纒尚要觀疊數，一疊回來龍身顧。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032866331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"莫便将為真實看，此是䕶龍葉交互。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032882715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"三重五重抱回來，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032899099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"此就枝龍腰上做。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032899099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"幹龍尤自隨水去，䕶送迢迢不四顧。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032915483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"正龍身上不生峰，有峰皆是枝葉送。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032931867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"君如見此幹龍身，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032948251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625595438"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"的向幹龍窮處覔。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032948251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"君如尋得幹龍窮，二水相交穴受風。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032964635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"風吹水刼却非穴，君如到此是疑龍。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032981019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"請君看水交纒處，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032997403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"水外有山來聚會。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352032997403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"翻身顧母顧祖宗，此是回龍轉身處。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033013787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"宛轉回龍是掛鈎，未作穴時先作朝。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033030171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"朝山皆是宗與祖，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033046555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"不舉千里逺迢迢。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033046555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"穴前諸官皆拜揖，千源萬𣲖皆朝入。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033062939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"此是尋龍大法門，两水夾來皆轉揖。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033079323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"尋龍何處使人疑，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033095707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"尋得星峯却是枝。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033095707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"枝葉亂來無正穴，真龍到處又疑非。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033112091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"只縁不識两邊䕶，却愛飛峰到脚隨。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033128475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"飛峰斜落是龍脚，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033144859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625611822"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"脚上生峰一邊卓。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033144859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍平處無星峰，两邊生峰至難捉。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033161243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"背斜靣直號飛峰，此是真龍夾從龍。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033177627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"一節生峰一節挿，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033194011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"两節雖長號寛峽。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033194011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"峽長繞出真龍前，背後星峰又可憐。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033210395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"到此狐疑不能識，請向正龍尋两邊。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033226779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"两邊起峰為䕶從，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033243163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"正龍低平最貴重。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033243163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"星峰两邊轉前揖，揖在穴前為我用。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033259547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"問君州縣正身龍，大浪横江那有峰。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033275931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"起峰皆是两邊脚，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033292315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"去為小穴為村落。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033292315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"如此尋龍看两邊，两邊生脚未嘗偏。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033308699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"正身遶𨚫中央去，禄破文廉多作關。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033325083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"關門是為有大小，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033341467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625628206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"破禄二星外為攔。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033341467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存無禄作神壇，破軍不破作近關。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033357851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"要尋大地尋闗局，闗局大小水口山。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033374235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡尋龍要尋幹，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033390619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"莫道無星又無換。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033390619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"君如不識枝幹龍，毎見幹龍多誕謾。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033407003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"不知幹長纒亦長，外山外縣山為伴。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033423387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"尋龍千里逺迢遞，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033439771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"其次五百三百里。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033439771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"先就輿圖看水源，两水夾來皆有氣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033456155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"水源自是有長短，長作軍州短作縣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033472539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"枝上節節是郷村，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033488923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"幹上時時斷復斷。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033488923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"分枝劈胍散亂去，幹中有枝枝復幹。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033505307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"凡有枝龍長百里，百里周圍作一縣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033521691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"百里各有小幹龍，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033538075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625644590"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"两水峽來尋曲㟁。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033538075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"曲巗有水抱龍頭，抱處好尋氣無散。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033554459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"到此先看水口山，水口交牙內局寛，便就寛容平處覔。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033570843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"左右周圍無空閒，斷然有穴在此處。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033587227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"更看朝水與朝山，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033603611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"朝水與龍一般逺。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033603611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"共祖同宗來作伴。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033619995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"客山千里來作朝，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033636379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"朝在靣前為近案。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033636379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"如有朝迎情性真，将相公侯立可斷。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033652763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"尋得真龍不識穴，不識穴時總空説。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033669147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"識龍識穴始為真，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033685531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"下着真龍官不絶。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033685531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍隠拙穴難尋，惟有朝山識倖心。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033701915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"朝若髙時髙處㸃，朝若低時低處針。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033718299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"朝山亦自有真假，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033734683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625660974"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"若是真時特來也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033734683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"若是假時山不來，徒愛尖圓巧如畵。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033751067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"若有真朝來入懐，不必尖圓如龍馬。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033767451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"惟要低昻起伏來，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033783835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"不愛尖傾直去者。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033783835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"直去名為墜朝山，雖見尖圓也是閒。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033800219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如貴人背靣立，與我情意不相關。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033816603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有横列為朝者，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033832987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"若是横朝似衙喏。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033832987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"前山横過脚分枝，枝上作朝首先下。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033849371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"首下作峰或尖圓，隻隻來朝列我前。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033865755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"大作排牙小作列，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033882139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"如魚駢頭蠶比肩。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033882139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"朝餘却去作水口，與我後纒两相凑。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033898523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"交牙護斷水不流，不放一山一水走。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033914907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"到此尋穴定明堂，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033931291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625677358"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂横直細推别。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033931291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"横城寛抱有垣星，更以三垣論交結。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033947675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"交結多時垣氣深，交結少時垣局洩。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033964059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"長垣便是横朝班，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033980443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"局心便是明堂山。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033980443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"鈎鈴垂脚向垣口，北靣重重尊聖顔。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352033996827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵山形雖在地，地有精光屬星次。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034013211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"體魂在地光在天，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034029595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"識得星光真精藝。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034029595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂惜水如惜血，穴裏避風如避賊。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034045979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"莫令穴缺被風吹，莫使溜牙遭水劫。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034062363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"問君如何辨明堂，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034078747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"外山抱裏內平洋。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034078747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"也有䕶關亦如此，君若到此細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034095131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"時師毎到關峽裏，山水周圍秀且麗。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034111515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"躊躇四顧説明堂，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034127899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625693742"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"妄指横山作真地。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034127899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"不知關峽自周圍，只是䕶關堂洩氣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034144283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"洩氣之法妙何觀，左右雖回外無攔。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034160667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"此是正龍䕶關峽，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034177051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"莫将堂局此中看。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034177051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"與君細論明堂様，明堂須要之𤣥放。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034193435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂遶曲如遶繩，遶在穴前須內向。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034209819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"內向之水抱身横，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034226203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"對靣抱來弓帯象。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034226203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"上山下來下山上，中有吉穴隨形向。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034242587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"形若真時穴始真，形若不真是虚誑。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034258971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"虚誑之山看两邊，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034275355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"两邊虚穴亦如然。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034275355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"外纒不轉內托𨑰，此是貴龍形氣散。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034291739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"龍虎背後有衣裾，此是官闌拜舞袖。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034308123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然有袖穴不見，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034324507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625710126"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"官不離郷任何受。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034324507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"貴龍行處有氊褥，氊褥之龍富貴局。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034340891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"問君氊褥如何分，龍下有坪如鱉裙。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034357275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如貴人有拜席，","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034373659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"又如僧道壇具伸。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034373659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍到穴有祵褥，便是枝龍山富足。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034390043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"此是神仙識貴龍，莫道肥龍多息肉。","logicSentenceId":"7666016352034406427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"瘦龍雖是孤寒山，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819627035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"也有瘦龍出髙官。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819627035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"肥龍須作貴龍體，也有肥龍反凌替。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819643419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"問君肥瘦如何分，莫把雌雄妄輕議。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819659803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"大戴亦嘗有此言。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819676187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"溪谷為牝低伏蹲，岡陵為牡必雄峙，不知肥瘦有殊分。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819692571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"漢儒以山論夫婦，夫山髙峻婦低去。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819708955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"此是儒家論尊卑，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819725339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625726510"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"便是龍家雌雄語。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819725339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵肥龍要瘦䕶，瘦龍也要肥龍御。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819741723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"瘦龍若有裀褥形，千里封侯居此地。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819758107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"敢将禹跡來問君，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819774491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"輿圖之上要細論。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819774491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"尋龍論胍尤論勢，地勢如何却屬坤。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819790875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"若以山川分两界，黄河川江两源派。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819807259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"其中有枝濟與河，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819823643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"淮漢湘水亦長源。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819823643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"幹中有枝枝有幹，長者入海短入垣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819840027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"若以幹龍會大盡，太行碣石至海瓀。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819856411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"又有髙山入韋嶺，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819872795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"又分汝潁河流吞。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819872795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"南幹分枝入海內，河北河東皆不背。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819889179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"蔥","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819905563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"嶺連緜入桂連，又入衡陽到江邊。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819905563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"其間屈曲分臂去，不","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819921947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625742894"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"知多少枝葉繁。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819921947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"又分一𣲖入東海，又登碣石會為垣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819938331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819954715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"枝分送入海門，幹龍盡在江隂墳。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819954715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"若以幹龍為至貴，東","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819971099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"南沿海天中尊。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819971099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"如何垣星不在彼，多在枝龍身上分。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998819987483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"到","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820003867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"彼枝幹又難辨，枝上多為州與縣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820003867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"京都多是在中原，海","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820020251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"岸山窮風蕩散。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820020251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"君如要識枝幹龍，更看疑龍中下卷","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820036635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然巳識枝中幹，長作京都短作縣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820069403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"枝中有幹幹有枝，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820085787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"心裏能明口能辨。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820085787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"只恐尋龍到此窮，两水夾來風蕩散。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820102171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625759278"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"也有方州并大邑，直到水窮山絶巗。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820118555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"也有城隍一都會，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820134939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"深在山原隈僻畔。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820134939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"今日君尋到水窮，砂礫坦然纒䕶竄。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820151323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"右尋無穴左無形，無穴無形却尋轉。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820167707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"尋轉分枝上覔穴，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820184091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"惟見縱横枝葉亂。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820184091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"也識轉換，也識纒，也識䕶托也識斷，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820200475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"只是狐疑難捉穴。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820200475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"穴若假時無正案，到此之時心生疑。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820216859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇髙明能剖判，為君決破之疑心，枝幹亂時分背靣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820233243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"假","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820249627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"如两水夾龍來，便看外纒那邊回。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820249627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"纒山纒水回抱處，背","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820266011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"底纒山纒水隈。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820266011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"䕶纒亦自有大小，大小隨龍長短來。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820282395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"龍","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820298779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625775662"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"長纒䕶亦長逺，龍短纒䕶亦近挨。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820298779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵纒山必回轉，莫","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820315163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"把明堂向外截。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820315163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"曲轉之形必是靣，只恐朝山塞不開。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998820331547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId ll},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡幹龍行盡處，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821101595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"外山隔水來相顧。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821101595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"幹龍若是有鬼山，回轉向前寛處安。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821117979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"凡山大曲水大轉，必有王侯居此間。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821134363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"也有幹龍夾两水，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821150747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"更不回頭直為地。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821150747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"只是两䕶必不同，定有䕶闗交結秘。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821167131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"幹龍行盡若無鬼，須看衆水聚何處。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821183515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"衆水聚處是明堂，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821199899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"左右交牙鎖真氣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821199899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"如此明堂雖是真，鎖結交牙誠可貴。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821216283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"問君疑龍何處難，两水之中必有山。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821232667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"两山之中必有水，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821249051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"山水相夾是機源。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998821249051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"假如十條山同聚，必有十水歸一處。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865764362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625857582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"其間一水是出門，九山同來作門戸。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865780746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"東行看西西山好，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865797130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"西上看東東山妙。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865797130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"南山望見北上山，山竒水秀疑似間。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865813514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"北上看見南山水，矗矗尖竒秀且麗。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865829898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"君如遇見此處時，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865846282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"两水夾來何處是？","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865846282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"與君更為何分别，先分貴賤星羅列。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865862666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"更須叅究龍短長，又看頓伏星善良。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865879050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"尊星不肯為朝見，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865895434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"從龍雖來撓掉藏。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865895434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"貴龍重重出入帳，賤龍無帳空雄强。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865911818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"十山九水難同聚，貴龍居中必異常。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865928202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"問君如何分貴賤，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865944586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍不肯為朝見。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865944586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"凡有星峯去作朝，此龍骨裏福潛消。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865960970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625873966"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如吏兵與臣僕，終朝跪起庭前伏。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865977354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"那有精神立自身，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865993738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"時師只説同闗局。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998865993738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"朝山䕶送豈無穴，輕重多與貴龍别。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866010122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"龍無貴賤只論長，纒龍逺出前更强。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866026506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"若徒論長不論貴，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866042890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"纒龍有穴反為良。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866042890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"只恐尋龍易厭斁，雖有眼力無脚力。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866059274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"若不窮源論祖宗，也尋頓伏識真踪。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866075658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"古人尋龍尋頓伏，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866092042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"葢縁頓伏生尖曲。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866092042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"曲轉之餘必生枝，枝上必為小關局。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866108426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如人行適千里，豈無解鞍并頓宿。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866124810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"頓宿之所雖未住，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866141194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有從行并部曲。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866141194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"頓伏移換并退卸，𨚫看山靣何方下。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866157578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852222625890350"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"移換却須尋回山，山回却有迎送還。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866173962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"迎送相從識龍靣，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866190346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"龍身背上是纒山。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866190346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"纒山轉來龍抱體，此中尋穴又何難。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866206730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"古人建都與建邑，先尋頓伏識龍關。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866223114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"升虚望楚與陟巘，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866239498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"此是尋頓與山靣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866239498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"降觀於桑與降原，此是尋伏下平田。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866255882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"度其夕陽揆以日，南北東西向無失。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866272266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"乃陟南岡景於京，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866288650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"此是望穴識龍形。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866288650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"陟彼百泉觀水去，陟彼溥原觀水聚。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866305034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"或陟南岡與太原，是尋頓伏非茍然。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866321418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"古人卜宅貴詳審，","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866337802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"經㫖分明與後傳。","logicSentenceId":"7666016998866337802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"穴場金魚水界圓暈在隠微之間者為太極。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709176374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"上是微茫","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709192758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"水分，下是微茫水合，合處為小明堂，容人側卧，便是穴","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709192758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"場。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709192758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"有此圓暈，則生氣內聚，故為真穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709209142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"立標枕對於此而","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709225526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"定，無此者非也。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709225526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"若暈頂再見一二半暈，如初三夜月様","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709241910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"者，名曰天輪影有三輪者，大地也。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709241910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"暈間凹陷者為隂穴，凸起者為陽穴，是謂两儀。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709274678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"就身作","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709291062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"穴者為隂龍，宜陽穴；另起星峰作穴者為陽龍，宜隂穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709291062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"皆有饒減。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709307446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"或上截凸起，下截凹䧟；或下截凸起，上截凹","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709323830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"陷；或左右凹凸相兼者，為二氣相感，則取隂陽交媾之","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709323830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"中，升降聚會之所，不用饒滅。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709323830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
