{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"脈緩者，用蓋法，當掲髙放棺，以蓋覆為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709471286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"脈急者，用粘","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709487670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"法，當就低放棺，以粘綴為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709487670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"胍直者，用𠋣法，當挨偏放","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709504054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"棺，以𠋣靠為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709504054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"脈不急不緩而横者，用撞法，當取直放","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709520438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738708998"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"棺，以冲撞為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709520438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"巳上四法，髙山陽龍用之。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709536822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"息之緩而短者，用斬法，當近頂放棺，以斬破為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709553206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"息之","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709569590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"不緩不急而長者，用截法，當對腰放棺，以裁截為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709569590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"息","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709585974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"之低者用隊法，當凑脚臨頭放棺，以墜墮為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709585974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"巳上四","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709602358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"法，高山隂龍用之。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709602358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"窟之狹者用正法，當中心放棺，以中正為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709618742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"窟之闊者","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709635126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"用求法，當迎氣放棺，以求索為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709635126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"窟之深者用架法，當","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709651510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"抽氣放棺，四角立石，以架閣為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709651510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"窟之淺者用折法，當","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709667894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738725382"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"量胍放棺，淺深中半，以比折為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709667894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"已上四法，平地陽龍","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709684278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"用之。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709684278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"突之單者用挨法，當靠實放棺，以挨拶為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709700662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"突之雙者","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709717046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"用併法，當取短放棺，以兼併為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709717046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"𥥛之正者用斜法，當","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709733430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"閃仄放棺，以斜仄為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709733430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"突之偏者用挿法，當撥正放棺，","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709749814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"以栽挿為義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709749814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"巳上四法，平地隂龍用之。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709766198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋者蓋也，有如合盆之形。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709782582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋之脈，自坤而見于乾；蓋之","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709798966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"法，自乾而施于坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709798966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"垢復之妙存焉，天地之精見焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709815350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"頂薄","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709831734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738741766"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"則舍之，切勿踈畧，慎母茍且。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709831734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋小蓋大，則傷其元氣；蓋","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709848118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"大蓋小，則閉其生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709848118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋上蓋下，則脱其來氣；蓋下蓋上，","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709864502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"則失其止氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709864502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋左蓋右，或犯其剝氣；蓋右蓋左，或受其","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709880886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"冷氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709880886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"縱得龍穴之妙，必遭横逆之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709897270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"頂薄舍蓋云者，舍","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709913654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"之不用，非舍上就下，舍髙就卑之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709913654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"此以作穴言，彼","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709930038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"以審穴言，意義自别，穴法不殊，畧有差池，難致效騐。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709930038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"粘者，沾也，如沾恩寵之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709946422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"粘之脈，自來而止于止；粘之","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709962806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"法，自止而止于盡。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709962806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"施承之道攸存，化生之意將著，下薄","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709979190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738758150"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"莫粘焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709979190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"理法少差，天淵懸隔。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994709995574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"粘上粘下，則脱其來氣；粘","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710011958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"下粘上，則犯其暴氣；粘右粘左，則失其正氣；粘左粘右，","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710011958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"或投其死氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710011958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"縱得砂水之美，終是或承之羞。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710028342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"下薄莫粘","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710044726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"云者，棄之不用，非𣓪低取髙，𣓪下取上之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710044726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"茍粘之","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710061110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"真的，雖下臨長江大河，亦為無礙工巧，豈有下薄棄粘","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710061110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"之理乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710061110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"𠋣者，依也，如依居之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710077494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"𠋣之脈，自上而冲于下；𠋣之法，","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710093878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"自偏而傍于正。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710093878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"傍棲之形既成，𠮓化之道自現。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710110262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"𠋣左𠋣","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710126646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738774534"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"右或受冷，𠋣右𠋣左或犯剛，𠋣上𠋣下謂之脱脈，𠋣下","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710126646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"𠋣上謂之冲殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710126646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"縱得局靣之竒，必見衰凌之患。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710143030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"本與挨","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710159414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"法相似，但挨法施于𥤮之平，𠋣法用于脈之直。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710159414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"天精天","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710175798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"粹之機，至密至微之理，非上智其誰能知？","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710175798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"撞者抵也，如抵觸之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710192182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"撞之脈，自斜而就于正；撞之法，","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710208566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"自正而就于斜。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710208566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"斜來之脈既専，専一之情可見。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710224950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"撞上撞","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710241334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"下，則氣從上止；撞下撞上，則氣從下出。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710241334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"撞重撞輕，則生","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710257718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"氣虚行；撞輕撞重，則生氣太洩。","logicSentenceId":"7679532994710257718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"縱得來脈之真，終失正","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827777030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738790918"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"脈之吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827777030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"本與挿相似，但插施於𥤮之傍，而撞施于脈之","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827793414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"斜。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827793414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"一毫千里之逺，江河几席之間，不可不察。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827809798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"斬者斷也。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827826182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"斬竊其生氣，生氣見于息之横。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827842566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"髙不可侵頂，","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827858950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"頂暈薄也；低不可近足，足㡳寒也。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827858950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"是以斬上恐失下，斬","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827875334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"下怕失上，斬左右恐失中心，斬中心恐失左右。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827875334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"細觀息","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827891718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"象明白，次觀穴情的當，然後以斬法施之，則上下左右","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827891718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"自成體叚。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827891718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"然息則體之微也，斬則用之廣也，若不細察，","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827908102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"遽爾投棺，則生氣受傷，子母遭挫，縱得包藏之固，終非","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827908102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738807302"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"可久之道。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827908102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"且息象用斬，其息必小，小則難以投其大；斬","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827924486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"施于息，其塋必大，大則難以容于小。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827924486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"必極到之理能明，","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827940870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"斯中和之義自見。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827940870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"截者剖也，剖闢其生氣，生氣露于息之直，髙若侵巔，謂","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827957254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"之剖首，低若站麓，謂之剖足。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827957254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"是以截上恐遺下，截下恐","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827973638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"遺上，截左恐失右，截右恐失左。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827973638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"呵氣而成，謂之一息，一","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827990022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"息既成，貼于穴體，穴體微茫，切勿輕舉。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392827990022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"斬之息多土意，","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828006406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"截之息多木意。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828006406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"横土用斬，截盡生意，直垂用截，接盡生","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828022790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738823686"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"意，勢不相侔，作用逈異。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828022790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"若不細玩，遽爾輕投，則體用两","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828039174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"傷，生氣破洩，雖有美潤之玉，恐損雕琢之手。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828039174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵脈息","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828055558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"之穴，不可雙葬，正謂寧失之小，莫失之大，此言極當。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828055558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"吊者懸也，懸提其生氣，生氣直奔入于息下。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828071942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"上不可過髙，","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828088326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"恐漏其氣；下不可過低，恐犯其氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828088326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"一隂既息，諸陽來復，","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828104710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"半在息體之足，半在息體之襯。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828104710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"氣交感而成形，形既完","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828121094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"而成穴。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828121094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"左右自無可混，上下最宜斟酌。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828137478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"若不細用心思，","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828153862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"則首受殺伐，足踐風寒，左右雖有纒綿，本主自難抵敵。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828153862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738840070"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵與粘相似，但粘乃吊之垂，吊乃粘而起。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828170246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"因材施用","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828186630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"之道，量職官人之義，須當此處辨之。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828186630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"墜者落也，墜落其滴露。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828203014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣既完，如菓脱蒂，上不可頂","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828219398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"脈而扦，下不可離脉而作。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828219398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"頂不離弦，來意專一；足不離","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828235782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"褥，生意直遂。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828235782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"息體豐盛，褥弦展轉，穴星軒昻，吐出泡脈。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828252166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"墜左則就于偏枯，墜右則入于偏駁，墜下則來而不來，","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828268550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"墜上則止所非止。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828268550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"須審吐落之情，竝依墜落之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828284934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"若有","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828301318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"怠忽，必失本體。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828301318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"親上要退其剛硬之枯，就下要舒其呼","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828317702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738856454"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"吸之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828317702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"髙不如吊，低不如粘，是為得之。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828334086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"正者整也。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828350470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"整肅其身體，收斂其精神。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828366854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"窟象既小，生氣初","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828383238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"凝，過于大，未免傷其元氣之真；入于深，豈不傷其細嫩","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828383238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"之體？","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828383238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"損其元氣，則精神不足，壊其細嫩，則本體不完。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828399622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"古","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828416006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"今𦵏者雖多，未必盡曉此法。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828416006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"是以地吉而人不吉，地美","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828432390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"而人不美也。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828432390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有上下之誤，豈無左右之偏？","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828448774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽妙合，","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828465158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"歸于中正之天；剛柔相濟，止于中正之地。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828465158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"三分損益，一","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828481542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"理推行，自然吻合。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828481542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738872838"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"求者度也。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828497926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"量度其大之止，追求其止之真。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828514310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"窟象既大，生","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828530694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"氣瀰漫，過于大，則氣流而不專；過于小，則氣遊而不息。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828530694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"流而不專，則度之未真；遊而不息，則求之未切。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828547078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"雖見窩","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828563462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"象分明，下穴百無一發，是能求之于穴，不能求之于求","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828563462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828563462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有髙低之錯，豈無淺深之差？","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828579846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"一真吐露，六義均停。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828596230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"一見了然，五行自著。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828612614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"上不容下，下不必上，斯義得之。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828628998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"架者加也。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828645382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"加加于木，故名曰架。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828661766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"窟象既深，下藏隂殺，上","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828678150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"而畏風，故氣聚下；下而畏濕，故氣泊上。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828678150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"下上受敵，故氣","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828694534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738889222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"凝中。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828694534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"失之于上，難免暴敗之禍；失之于下，必受隂消之","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828710918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"患。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828710918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"故當度其乗氣之源，定其止聚之基。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828727302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"須先用木以滲","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828743686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"其凶暴之情，然後加棺以顓其融溢之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828743686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"水性就下，下","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828760070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"之隂殺見木即消。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828760070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"隂殺侵上，上之暴氣遇風即散。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828776454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"生意","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828792838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"不窮，嗣續蕃盛。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828792838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"若執夫窩不𦵏心之説，是未明通𠮓之","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828809222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"方者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828809222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"又有一法，破土尺餘，四角立石架棺，六合打牆","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828825606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"培土。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828825606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"此須玄武髙，龍虎壓，乃可爾耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828841990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"天地玄機，由人幹","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828858374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"運，須憑目巧，總在心靈。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828858374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738905606"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"折者，裁也，以斤裁物，故名曰折。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828874758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"窟象既淺，四顧茫然。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828891142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"立","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828907526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"于上，須要砂水均應，立于下，須看龍虎相登。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828907526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"若無包藏，","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828923910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"則殺乗風旺；若有風殺，則氣隨風散。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828923910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"風旺則殺愈熾，氣","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828940294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"散則殺愈侵。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828940294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"故生氣之避殺氣，猶君子之避小人。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828956678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"須審","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828973062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"其出彼入此之真機，預究其參前𠋣後之大勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828973062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"折中","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828989446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"其上下，分按其左右，深不過五，淺不失一，而折之義詳","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828989446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392828989446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵正與架相似，而正則架之深；折與求相似，而折","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829005830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"則求之濶。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829005830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"同而異，異而同，少有差殊，則施于甲者不免","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829022214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738921990"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"施於乙，用于丙者不免用于丁，欲求福祉，恐難致騐。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829022214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"挨者，傍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829038598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"傍切其生氣，𥥛象既彰，隂脈單現，渺茫無際，","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829054982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"恍惚無棲。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829054982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"無際則居止難定，無棲則捉摸難依。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829071366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":294,"lineType":2,"content":"闕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"須傍藉生生之氣，借資化","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829087750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"270","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"化之機，上不投其急，而暴氣冲和，下不受其寒，而隂氣","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829104134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"旋復，此挨之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829104134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"挨與𠋣相似，而挨則𠋣之切；𠋣與挨","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829120518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"各别，而𠋣則挨之寛。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829120518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"可挨處，如種之方芽，龍之將蟄；當","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829136902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"挨處，形如轉皮，氣如仰掌。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829136902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738938374"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"併者，合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829153286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"合併其生氣，𥥛象兩彰，隂脈重現，如浮鷗傍","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829169670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"母之形，若嘉粟吐華之勢。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829169670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"或兩脈顯其長短，或二突露","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829186054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"其巨細。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829186054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"投其左則情意不專，投其右則生意不固。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829202438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"情意","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829218822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"不專，或值隂駁之禍；生意不固，乃值亡陽之殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829218822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"故須乗","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829235206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"其短而小者穴之，合其大而長者併之，相依不散，理勢","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829235206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"通同，斯則元辰完固而不傷，理氣合一而不散，大義自","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829235206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"覺，無事瑣瑣。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829235206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"斜者切也，斜切其生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829251590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"凡見突脈直下，棺骸切莫授首。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829267974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738954758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"挨其弦，則脈絡不到，就其頂，則氣勢猖强。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829284358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"不到之處，謂","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829300742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"之退落；猖强之處，謂之剛雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829300742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"退落則陽中之陽偏，陽不","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829317126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"生也；剛雄則隂中之隂偏，隂不成也。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829317126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"故斜而切之，斜則","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829333510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"不直，受其暴氣；切則不疎，逺其真情。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829333510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"凶可去而吉可得，","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829349894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"禍患逺而福德旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829349894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽相扶，急緩相濟，而斜穴之名義","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829366278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829366278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"挿者下也，下挿其生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829382662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"凡見突脈之斜，須詳作穴之義。","logicSentenceId":"7679533392829399046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"迎其來，則去處牽扯；就其止，則來處棲遲。","logicSentenceId":"7679533758940184582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"故乗其過續","logicSentenceId":"7679533758940200966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852549738971142"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"之中，挿之以枯朽之骨。","logicSentenceId":"7679533758940200966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"可挿處，脈情活動，如横抛之勢；","logicSentenceId":"7679533758940217350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"當挿處，穴情昭著，似直撞之形。","logicSentenceId":"7679533758940217350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣磅礴，源源不絶，聚","logicSentenceId":"7679533758940233734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"氣充盛，浩浩難窮。","logicSentenceId":"7679533758940233734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"不絶則情意自專，難窮則功力自大，","logicSentenceId":"7679533758940250118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼福及人，效騐悠逺，斯挿法之理致極矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679533758940250118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
